full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Q is the sum of measured net masses at each unique first whole-product quality release, including the declared functional sleeve and retained constituent water once. Use calibrated scales and the same BOM/conditioning scope under cp_release. Already released closing FG is already in Q; do not subtract it as manufacturing closing output.

For one same-configuration complete article define measured net mass M using calibrated whole-article weighing under cp_release; for counted component lots use independently measured lot-specific unit mass, sample size and uncertainty. Convert count to mass before the single normalization. Never infer umbrella mass from carton shipping weight or a secondary property.

Weigh complete finished roll fabric as supplied. Area/length records require actual width and same-lot measured areal mass. Nonrectangular canopy area is measured from the real panel geometry, not a bounding rectangle. Coating, contained water and polyester remain non-additive composition subledgers of one purchased fabric.

Keep raw meter units and convert kWh × 3.6 to MJ once. Water mass is independently weighed; volume requires measured substance/state-specific density. Integrated gas/liquid volumes are not multiplied by time again; actual rates are integrated over the measured interval. Do not use water density for another substance or the native water secondary volume coefficient as a measured density.

Every physical receipt/dispatch/return/waste retains full gross V in its native unit and the correct Q or original Qc denominator. Allocation applies only to associated burden vectors and never scales the physical transfer. Incoming article mass and embedded component/water mass cannot both be added to the same side.

calculationRules.rule: Convert each raw numerator to its declared native unit before allocation: kWh × 3.6 = MJ; count × independently measured same-lot unit mass = kg; fabric area × independently measured same-lot areal mass = kg; liquid volume × independently measured density at recorded state = kg; integrate an actual rate once. Preserve originals and uncertainty; no preset material factors.

Keep complete physical raw/WIP/non-WIP/FG/return, packaging, installed-fluid and every actual equipment-fleet ledger separate from reference events and per-exchange burden vectors. Own opening WIP carries actual earlier foreground burdens once; only substantiated still-unused/unassigned closing WIP carries them forward. For attribution, A may add unassigned inherited opening burden to period raw burden and remove only demonstrated still-unassigned closing burden and a disjoint justified other-system/cohort handover. Already-net consumption is not stock-corrected a second time; accepted closing FG and services already performed for it are not deleted. A complete provider aggregate and its embedded material/transport/asset/history decomposition are mutually exclusive. Preserve failed attempts, idle/start-stop, inspection, samples, cleanout and repair loads. Actual complete upstreams match the whole supplied article/preparation and true availability point; no receipt or purchased-service label hides known on-site manufacture. Actual provider inclusion schedules cover current electricity, repair, transport and operating supplies as well as capital: an aggregate already including a metered foreground operation and that separate operation cannot both be charged. For an independently unassigned burden vector only, A_i=O_unassigned_i+B_period_i-C_still_unassigned_i-H_disjoint_other_i; actual original cohorts and provider coverage determine each term, never physical residual fitting.

result_i = N_i / D_c, once only. N_i is complete native gross V_i for every physical flow, or A_i for an allocated utility/service burden; D_c is Q of new first-release manufacture or original Qc of the observed service cohort. Q and Qc are measured kg at original release; keep cohort results separate before an explicit mass-weighted combination. For D_c=0 retain raw N_i and vectors without a unit result. first_whole_release is exactly 1 kg by definition.

collectionProtocols.collection_method: Count/weigh each packaging article and every actual purchase/return/dispatch/disposal; reconcile empty, attached and reusable pools. Internal reuse cancels; do not collect pre-divided values or multiply an acquisition burden for each trip. For each actual whole wet corrugated-carton, PE-bag, sealing-tape or plastic-crate pool use O_empty+O_attachedWIP+O_attachedFG+O_reusable+P+I_other+ERin+J_in+H2O_in-X_in=C_empty+C_attachedWIP+C_attachedFG+C_reusable+S_gross+EOout+W_whole+J_out+H2O_out-X_out. I_other is the sum of actual separately identified otherwise received whole packaging, including real supplier-included packaging when present, distinct from P and ERin and not another purchase; internal reuse R_internal cancels between matched positions and is not I_other. J is additional real non-water material and H2O is additional actual water transfer only to the extent not already included in another whole wet leg. O/C and every whole leg retain all contained matter: actual new material/water retained in C never erases its true influx. X subtracts only independently proved overlap with OTHER same-side flow terms, never C, real increments, opposite directions or card existence. Trace actual J/water sources/destinations with specific physical records and internal pairs; do not invent a generic provider, extra Q, separate constituent waste or balancing flow. Gross shipments, external returns received/sent and true whole waste stay physically full regardless of environmental use shares. These four specific article pools are conditional on actual configuration; these are actual conditional packaging choices, not a universal material, tare, repair, water uptake or mass. The inherited I cards mean this I_other whole-article transfer, never the internal R_internal loop or a generic unknown balancing addition.

collectionProtocols.collection_method: Every actual sewing machine, cutting tool, tool, extraction/handling unit and reusable cloth keeps a complete actual configured fleet: new/used receipts, external returns received/sent, real retirement/whole waste, installed/opening/closing holdings and disjoint repair/fluid changes. Actual service h must match a complete real provider history and observed original-cohort use, unused/unassigned capacity and inherited burdens; physical fleet kg is not scaled by a service share. Separately supplied oil/filter/belt and whole contaminated removed items need their own atomic interfaces when actually present; contained parts remain nested in a whole asset. Receipt/return/shipment/retirement cards disclose physical V only; they are not a second capital purchase when the actual compatible service history already owns the same upstream manufacture. Actual provider-service scope and separately metered operation/repair must be nonoverlapping. A cotton cloth has the same full gross receipt/return/whole-waste and opening/closing fleet record; actual laundering or replacement must carry all disjoint real provider and utility burdens. No cloth lifetime or laundering load is assumed.

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: This profile receives already finished canopy fabric and a complete frame. Matching sleeve colour or appearance does not prove the same fibre, finish or areal mass as the canopy. One polyester input card covers only real cuts from the same independently verified supplied textile; a genuinely different sleeve, reinforcement or strap material needs its own specific atomic article/provider and actual cutting record before completeness, never a guessed composition or duplicate whole-fabric purchase. Real prior fibre formation, weaving/dyeing/coating/printing and frame metallurgy/forming/finishing remain inside their complete compatible actual upstream providers once. An actual known on-site operation is not moved upstream by renaming a receipt. HF factory-tour fiberglass golf ribs, epoxy versus screws, eight-gores, test-cycle and spray examples are retained contrary context, not requirements for this steel-rib manual folding profile. Actual supplied finish chemistry, printed/dyed or RPET variants and all real order-specific operations must be disclosed; no finish, adhesive, fluorinated substance, cleaner molecule or emission is inferred. The actual whole assembled product is independently weighed in its declared conditioning state; a wet-dry article difference is not automatically water if finish, soil or other matter also changes. Establish liquid/retained/vapor water independently with actual compatible sampling and all real transfers; do not label a drain, droplet/mist or collected liquid as vapor. dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 本profile接收已完成整理的篷布及完整伞骨，配套伞套颜色或外观相同，不证明与篷面同纤维、整理或克重。一张聚酯投入卡仅含来自同一独立核实供货织物的真实裁片；真实不同的伞套、补强或收伞带材料须在完整前另有具体原子制品/提供者及真实裁剪记录，不猜组成或重复购整份布。真实此前成纤、织造/染色/涂层/印花及骨架冶金/成形/表面处理仍由完整兼容真实上游提供者计入一次。已知现场工序不因改名收货就纸面上移。HF工厂游览的玻纤高尔夫伞骨、环氧胶或螺钉、八片裁片、检验次数和喷淋例均保留为反证背景，不成为本钢骨手动折叠profile的要求。真实供货整理化学、印花/染色或RPET变体及全部真实订单工序须披露，不推断整理剂、胶、含氟物质、清洗剂分子或排放。实际完整组装产品按声明调湿状态独立称重，若整理物、污物或其他物料也变化，整伞湿干差不自动是水。液态/留存/蒸气水须以真实兼容采样和全部实际交接独立建立，不把排水、雾滴或收集液体叫蒸气。实际需要已识别红外活性蒸气测量时，留存完整EPA320及实际FTIR Protocol在真实适用范围内提供加热抽取输送/参考光谱/干扰/背景/状态/分析物加标回收及不确定性程序。它不是颗粒/雾/总VOC方法，也不以FTIR测同核N2/O2/单原子Ar，不宣称特定来源真实排放、已校准参考、基质回收或现场资格。具日期完整50页PDF含FTIR Protocol/addendum/附录，不是未取得的引用。PDF16 Eq3/4用示踪物混合分数，同页DF>=10图注却矛盾：保留原字节，区分同一校正摩尔基准守恒phi=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_direct-tracer_native)，分母非零、匹配代表性及无未计损失混合，expected analyte=phi*analyte_direct+(1-phi)*analyte_native，与其倒数稀释比。此恒等式不提供数值浓度、设置或接受容差。完整Methods1–3保留实际源几何/测点/非旋流/尺寸/位置及校准速度/状态/密度/流量限制，Method3受限基质/干扰、N2/CO余量及氩遗漏不等于通用空气组成、纯N2或已测Ar。一个管道结果不自动覆盖无组织逸散源。真实收集冷凝液/雾/废水为一次完整湿接收事件，独立于实际最终释放物种/介质。真实必要且未建立的具体采样/保真/基质/相态程序仍hold，不由未来SOP或finitecheck解决。已建立适用程序中普通实际校准/采样/回收属研究资格，不证明方法不存在。不假定燃烧、锅炉、反应水或热干燥配方，真实现场生成须在完整前纳入真实完整生产者、燃料/空气/O2/水/物种/治理/能量/废物接口及适用方法。这些具日期EPA互联网副本不宣称法规符合或实际研究成功。
